rows.old_notes: 4th occurrence of the sibling-mismapping pattern (after sec_0076/77, sec_0097/98, sec_0147/148) - and the first one involving a TABLE rather than an image, confirming the bug isn't image-specific: any content block (image or table) near a heading transition on a shared page can be mismapped to the wrong sibling.
